card.name: Words just before 'administration'
card.fires_on: The word right before 'administration' or 'administered' in dosing text, such as the ADMIN of INTRATHECAL ADMINISTRATION, 'prior to', 'following', or a dose unit like m2 before 'administered'.

modes.label: Capitalised warning heading
modes.description: The ADMIN piece inside the all-caps heading INTRATHECAL ADMINISTRATION.
modes.example: WARNING: RISKS ASSOCIATED WITH INTRATHECAL<< ADMIN>>ISTRATION Intrathecal administration of ISOV

modes.label: Timing word before administration
modes.description: A linking word such as 'to' or 'following' placed right before the word administration.
modes.example: Prior<< to>> administration of Provocholine, determine

modes.label: Dose wording before administered
modes.description: A dose term such as weight or m2 that comes right before 'administered'.

card.writes: It seems to push the model toward expecting the word 'administration' or 'administered' next, and away from other forms of admin.
card.plain: It fires on the word just before 'administration' or 'administered' in dosing instructions.
